company.name: Vscout Football
company.shortDescription: > Vscout is the pro network for youth football — linking players, scouts & clubs through verified profiles, videos & performance data.
company.description: Vscout Football is a dynamic platform connecting all football stakeholders—players, scouts, agents, and coaches. By providing verified talent showcases and a vertical edge in player visibility, Vscout Football ensures fair opportunities for young players to shine. Our platform allows players to build their CVs by uploading details and videos, optimizing their chances of being noticed and advancing their football careers.
